name: GNeRF
aliases: GAN-based Neural Radiance Field without Posed Camera
definition: A two-phase end-to-end framework that jointly optimizes coarse camera poses and neural radiance fields using adversarial training, then refines them with photometric loss, enabling novel view synthesis from randomly initialized poses in complex scenes.
summary: GNeRF is a novel view synthesis method that jointly optimizes neural radiance fields and camera poses from uncalibrated images using a two-phase hybrid adversarial and photometric optimization scheme.
